description: Redesign the six core fleet pages with the new design system: DashboardPage, MyFleetsPage, VehiclesPage, TyresPage, TripsPage, InspectionsPage. className-only changes — preserve ALL JSX structure, API calls, TanStack Query hooks, state, event handlers, mutations, and routing. Depends on FEAT-001 (tokens + shared layout must already be in place).
steps: Apply the universal className mapping (documented in .agents/tasks/plan.md and context.json key_patterns) to DashboardPage.tsx: page title text-slate-900->text-white, subtitle text-[#5B6068]->text-slate-300; 'View Fleet Vehicles' button -> bg-brand-gold hover:bg-brand-warm-gold text-black; the 4 KPI cards bg-white border-slate-200 -> bg-cream border-gold-border with distinct coloured icon circles (vehicles blue, tyres emerald, trips purple, alerts status-coloured) and text-[#344054] metric values; the 1st Vehicle Fitment panel -> bg-cream border-gold-border, 'Depot Baseline Audit' badge -> bg-brand-gold text-black, 'Full Inspection View' button -> bg-dark-surface hover:bg-dark-card text-white with gold icon; vehicle spec strip bg-[#14161A] -> bg-[#17191D] border-gold-border/30 (keep white values + emerald/orange accents); fitted tyre registry table -> vanilla header bg-cream-200 text-[#344054], hover #FFF9E8, PASS badge solid bg-emerald-500 text-white; THI donut card + Operational Alerts card + Recent Trips table -> cream cards with gold borders, 'View All' links -> text-brand-gold, COMPLETED badge -> bg-emerald-500 text-white.

MyFleetsPage.tsx: title->text-white, subtitle->text-slate-300, 'Fleet Portfolio' badge->bg-cream-100 text-[#344054] border-gold-light; search input + status select -> bg-cream border-gold-border focus:border-brand-gold; 'Add Fleet' -> primary gold; fleet cards bg-white -> bg-cream border-gold-border (active ring-brand-gold/30), icon box->bg-cream-100 border-gold-light, 'Active Selection' badge->bg-brand-gold text-black, ACTIVE status->bg-emerald-500 text-white, metric mini-cells->bg-cream-50 border-gold-light text-[#344054]; 'Manage/Open Fleet' button bg-[#14161A]->bg-dark-surface hover:bg-dark-card text-white; Add Fleet modal backdrop->bg-black/70, card->bg-cream border-gold-border, header->bg-cream-100, inputs->bg-cream-50 border-gold-border focus:border-brand-gold, 'Register Fleet'->primary gold. Keep all form state + fetchFleets + handleAddFleetSubmit.

VehiclesPage.tsx: title/subtitle->white/light; 'Manage / Add Fleet'->secondary light (bg-cream border-gold-light), '+ Add Vehicle'->primary gold; THI section panel->bg-cream border-gold-border; filter tabs active->bg-brand-gold text-black, inactive->bg-cream text-slate-500; the 4 THI metric cards bg-slate-50->bg-cream-50 border-gold-border with solid status pills; empty-state card->cream + 'Add First Vehicle' primary gold; vehicles table->vanilla header bg-cream-200 text-[#344054], hover #FFF9E8, THI/Status badges solid emerald/amber/red, action buttons 'Fit Tyres'->primary gold, 'Details'/'3D View'/'2D Inspection'/'Trips'->secondary light bg-cream border-gold-light; Add Vehicle modal->cream card + cream inputs + primary gold submit. Keep all useMutation/createVehicleMutation logic.

TyresPage.tsx: title->text-white, subtitle->text-slate-300; 3 summary cards bg-white border-slate-200 -> bg-cream border-gold-border keeping the coloured top accent (border-t-2 border-t-emerald-400 / border-t-[#E8770E] / border-t-red-400), values text-slate-900->text-[#344054]; search input->bg-cream border-gold-border focus:border-brand-gold; health filter pills active->solid bg-emerald-500/amber-500/red-500 text-white, 'All' active->bg-brand-gold text-black border-gold-border, inactive->bg-cream text-slate-500 border-gold-light; status dropdown->input mapping. Keep all useQuery + filter logic.

TripsPage.tsx: title/subtitle->white/light; 'Refresh' button->bg-dark-surface border-white/10 text-white with RefreshCw text-brand-gold; vehicle-filter banner->bg-cream border-gold-border, 'View All Vehicles'->secondary light; filter bar card->bg-cream border-gold-border, selects/inputs->input mapping, 'Reset Filters'->text-brand-gold; trips table->vanilla header, hover #FFF9E8, trip score >=85 number text-brand-gold, COMPLETED badge->bg-emerald-500 text-white, in-progress->bg-amber-500 text-white, 'Breakdown' button->secondary light; trip breakdown modal backdrop->bg-black/70, card->bg-cream border-gold-border, score box + component rows bg-blue-50 border-blue-200->bg-cream-100 border-gold-light, explanation bg-slate-100->bg-cream-50. Keep all useSearchParams + selectedTrip logic.

InspectionsPage.tsx: title/subtitle->white/light; 'Log Physical Inspection'->primary gold; inspections table->vanilla header bg-cream-200 text-[#344054], hover #FFF9E8, NSD value->text-[#344054]; result badges getResultBadge: PASS->bg-emerald-500 text-white, WARNING->bg-amber-500 text-white, FAIL->bg-red-500 text-white, FURTHER_ASSESSMENT->bg-purple-500 text-white; lifecycle badges getLifecycleBadge: NEW/REUSE/RETREAD/SCRAP->solid green/blue/amber/red white text; visual condition badge NORMAL->bg-emerald-500 text-white else->bg-amber-500 text-white; photo 'Attached'->text-brand-gold; modal backdrop->bg-black/70, card bg-white border-blue-200->bg-cream border-gold-border, inputs->input mapping, lifecycle decision box border->border-gold-light, SCRAP warning->bg-red-500/10 border-red-500/30, 'Record Inspection' bg-blue-600->primary gold bg-brand-gold text-black. Keep all createInspectionMutation + FormData logic.
acceptance_criteria: All six pages build with npm run build exiting 0.
Every data table on these pages has a vanilla header (bg-cream-200 text-[#344054]) and hover row #FFF9E8.
Every primary action button uses bg-brand-gold; every status badge is solid with white text.
No TypeScript interface, API URL, query hook, mutation, state variable, event handler, or JSX element/prop was changed or removed on any of the six pages.
